audit.whatIsWrong: The page leans on Riposte against Rumble without saying what it actually does, and gives no cooldowns.
audit.why: Nothing in Rumble's kit immobilises — Electro Harpoon and The Equalizer are slows, Scrap Shield is a shield plus move speed — so Riposte here can only parry damage and slow, never stun. The Rumble-side audit reached the same conclusion. Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s and burns for 3 seconds, so the cone keeps ticking after the parry ends. Scrap Shield is a flat 6s, far shorter than the page's 'bait it' framing implies.
audit.corrected: All three facts written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Scrap Shield is named as the tracked cooldown with no duration.
audit.why: At 6s it is not a window you wait out — the real timers to play around are Flamespitter's 10s and his heat bar.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Rumble must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bladework online: the guaranteed-crit Vital combo out-trades his pre-Overheat Flamespitter, so take the short rotation.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Rumble carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: The whole test is sidestepping Electro Harpoon; dodge the slow and the duel is one-sided, eat it and Overheat claws it back.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Scrap Shield is only 6s — bait it, then commit on the next one. - Flamespitter: 10s at rank 1 and it burns for 3 seconds, so it ticks past your parry. - Riposte cannot stun him: nothing in his kit immobilises.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Land Electro Harpoon', 'Drop Equalizer' and "Electro Harpoon's" — all THREE are FALSE POSITIVES (correct names with a leading verb or a possessive). The Rumble-side audit's central finding, that Riposte never stuns in this matchup, is now stated on the Fiora side too, so the two pages agree. Electro Harpoon's listed 0.5s cooldown is a per-charge recharge on a 2-charge ability, so I did not print it as a cooldown to play around.
